matrix_to_rot_scale — REPRCONV algebra op

• Data kinds: matrix → rot_scale

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.matrix_to_rot_scale(matrix) (to call the implementation directly, import reprconv; reprconv.matrix_to_rot_scale(matrix); from the registry, opsreprconv.get("matrix_to_rot_scale"))

Usage

A 2-D similarity transform (2,2) → (angle [deg], scale). The inverse of rot_scale_to_matrix.

The scale is the column norm, the angle is atan2(m[1,0], m[0,0]). Passing a general (2,2) that contains shear raises no exception (only the similarity part is read), so when you need a residual, compute m - rot_scale_to_matrix(...) on the caller's side.

Args:

matrix: (2, 2).

Returns:

2-tuple of float (angle_deg, scale).

Raises:

ValueError: not (2,2) / degenerate (scale 0) / non-finite.
